/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if test -f /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/154cd6807667/workspace/round-brief.md; then sed -n '1,240p' /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/154cd6807667/workspace/round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
printf '\\n--- registry.ts ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '\\n--- registry.test.ts ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' scripts/eslint-require-spec-link.mjs 2>/dev/null || true

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test(tools): cover dynamic input schemas" && git push origin HEAD'
